subtitle: The narrative frame of 2026.
description: The narrative frame of 2026 — Battle for Middle-earth.
quote.text: All that is gold does not glitter, not all those who wander are lost.
intro_p1: Shadows long as ages fall upon Middle-earth. The Free Peoples raise their standards, while from the north and from the south the steps of those who serve the Shadow are heard again.
